name: The Joker
about: Gradient-boosted trees (binomial deviance, depth 4, 25 rounds, learning rate 0.1, at least 5 games a leaf) on every number the job has before tip-off: the market's moneyline chance, line and total, Team Elo, the player model on the previous game's lineup, the play-offs and the day of the season, rest, back to backs, three in four nights, travel, altitude and a neutral site, same division or conference, the play-off series, each side's running efficiency and pace, the teams, both coaches and each side's top player by minutes in its previous game. Every call, a final's too, is worked out on what was known before its tip: the lines as the job last read them before tip-off, and every final of an earlier day and each club's coach as the game's Eastern day began; it reads no injury report. The spread is the home margin the chance implies. Fitted on 2022-23 to 2025-26 and never refitted in the job; a game with no moneyline posted gets no call.
